findings.title: Serverless versus dedicated deadlock
findings.detail: Mandatory serverless consumption tiers cannot coexist with mandatory customer-dedicated VMs for every workload—this deadlock requires sponsor arbitration before architecture boards proceed.

findings.title: Hosting edges blocked
findings.detail: Dedicated VM footprints contradict elastic serverless routing assumptions; topology automation should halt merges until one hosting story is explicitly waived.

findings.title: Control inheritance ambiguous
findings.detail: Encryption and isolation controls diverge between dedicated VM baselines and consumption plans; inheritance matrices stay ambiguous until licensing waivers publish.

findings.title: Dual posture budgeting
findings.detail: Finance cannot finalize RI versus serverless forecasts while contradictory mandates remain unresolved.
